_about: Rookie-draft slots (Rounds 1-5, drafts 2012-2025) traced back to their ORIGINAL owner by replaying every MFL pick trade (future-pick FP_<orig>_<year>_<round> trades, then current-pick DP_<round>_<slot> trades, slot zero-indexed), joined to that owner's prior-season final finish (src_final_standings / local metadata_finalstandings). Built 2026-10-17 read-only from a copy of the legacy mfl_database.db (transactions_trades, draftresults_combined, metadata_finalstandings). Only picks whose original owner is unambiguous are listed. The few rows that disagree with the canon table come from recorded finishes that are themselves wrong (2015 has two finish-6 teams; 2023 finish 9/10 are swapped against the game) or compensatory picks.
